data: This course will deliberate on the historical, political, ethical and literary concerns that frame the epic tale of Ramayana. We will explore the rich and diverse Ramayana tradition, delving into various retellings ranging from textual, to audio-visual to performance arts. Through the course, we will see how the Ramayana narratives have traveled, the story, story-tellers and the audiences, and how, if at all, do we read these various literary and cultural texts as historical sources.
